description: This file implements a Flutter widget 'ProjectsPage' that displays a list of projects. It allows creating, editing, and deleting projects, with interactions such as navigation to project forms, displaying project details, and handling project deletion with referential integrity updates.

classes.name: ProjectsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays and manages a list of projects, supporting creation, editing, and deletion of projects with UI dialogs and navigation.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the project creation form page.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the project editing form page with the provided project.

methods.name: _showProjectMenu
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet menu with options to edit or delete a specific project.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Asks for user confirmation to delete a project, and if confirmed, clears project references in tasks and deletes the project.
